title: Decorative Sniffer Eggs
description: Decorate with Sniffer Egg blocks without fear of hatching!

It is a continuation of Laynce's Decorative Sniffer Egg mod, that has been redesigned, and brought to newer versions of the game! Easy to use cartographer map trades

title: Integrated Stronghold
description: Integrated Stronghold is a mod that replaces the old and bland vanilla stronghold structure with a heavily detailed dungeon built with modded blocks from Create, Quark, and Supplementaries.
body:
FOR FORGE/FABRIC 1.19.2, 1.18.2, & 1.20.1

![This is an image](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/IntegratedStronghold/BH_NU_HEADER.webp)

Required Mods:

Integrated API 

Create

Supplementaries

Quark (forge only)




Optional Integrated Mods:

Biomes You'll Go

Biomes O' Plenty

Waystones

Farmer's Delight

Hexerei

Ars Nouvea

Mowzie's Mobs (1.18 only)

End Remastered (Datapack needed)

Alex's Mobs (Datapack needed)

The Graveyard (Datapack needed)

Dungeons Mobs (Datapack needed)

__________________________________________________________________________________________

 

WHAT IS INTEGRATED STRONGHOLD?
   

Integrated Stronghold is the second mod in the Integrated Structure series (the first being IDAS). Not only does it completely overhaul the boring old Minecraft stronghold structure with tons of heavily detailed rooms to explore, but it integrates Supplementaries/Quark decorations and Create mod doors, puzzles, traps, and more. It is the biggest generated structure dungeon you have ever explored, it takes up the maximum size possible in Minecraft. Additionally, it greatly expands upon the lore of the stronghold in Minecraft through lore books found in chests. I got sick of installing structure mods into a pack and roaming the world, only to find vanilla items and nothing of difficulty anywhere. I love detailed builds and Create machines, so I decided to make mods that adds exactly what I’ve been missing. Beautiful and challenging dungeons and structures packed with lore that are fully integrated into multiple core mods.


It is compatible with other stronghold mods (such as Yung's Better Strongholds) but it is HIGHLY recommended you only use this mod to preserve the integrated feeling and original intent.


I HIGHLY RECCOMEND USING ONE OR ALL OF THE OPTIONAL DATAPACKS TO ADD UNIQUE MOBS AND COMBAT

[Trailer video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bUFqx_kgi1c)

Configuration and optional Integration:

To enable optional integration, download these datapacks

End Remastered
Alex's Mobs
The Graveyard
Dungeons Mobs
If there is a mobs mod you want integrated, let me know!
 

To configure anything else, download this datapack

To change the spawn rate, change the spacing and separation in the structures set file. Spacing is the Average distance between two neighboring generation attempts. Value between 0 and 4096
Separation is the Minimum distance in chunks between two neighboring attempts. Value between 0 and 4096. Can't be bigger than spacing
To edit biomes, edit the biome files in tags/worldgen/biome/has structure
To change what mobs spawn throughout the structure, edit the integrated_structure_spawners files. Adding mobs to these is fairy straightforward, take a look at one of the optional datapacks if you need an example
 

Note: To use datapacks on a server, I recommend using a global datapack mod or KubeJS

 

Features:

Over 50 unique heavily detailed dungeon rooms making the experience different every time:

-  Unique small and detailed rooms including study rooms, kitchens, armories, mines, and more

-  Massive rooms to explore and uncover the secrets of including the portal room, grand library, dining hall, and more

-  Medium sized rooms such as prisons, fountains, enchanting rooms, portal rooms, and more

-  Tons of variations of trapped hallways to keep you on your toes

-  2 Custom made music discs by Cama to breath life into the stronghold. One can be found be crafting disc fragments found in the stronghold.

-  Lore books hidden in chests expanded upon the Minecraft lore greatly and giving the stronghold a true backstory and purpose in your world, while still leaving room for the player to piece together it's history.

-  Customized loot, weapons, and tools matching the lore books.

-  Create mod puzzles and traps to navigate

- Join my discord to make suggestions and influence my future projects!

 

If you have trouble finding the stronghold, use Eye of Enders to locate it or use "/locate integrated_stronghold:stronghold"

 

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q: What biome mods are compatible?

A: Most biome mods are compatible including Terralith, BOP, and BYG.

 

Q: Why are there so many dependencies?

A: Yes.


Q: Will you backport/update to ___?

A: I will always keep the mod up to date with the newest versions of Minecraft as the dependencies update. I am also currently working on the port to fabric

 

Q: Does this mod work with other structures mods?

A: Yes all of Yung's mods, Repurposed Structures and more will all work but it is HIGHLY recommended you only use this Stronghold overhaul mod. YUNG's Stronghold is good but the detail and integration put into this mod makes it miles more immersive and a better experience overall without question in my opinion. If you don't believe me try it out for yourself!

 

Q: Can I use this mod in a modpack?

A: Yes! I would love it if this mod gets used in packs.

 

Q: Can this mod be only on the server-side?
A: No, due to its custom music discs and soundtrack

 

Q: What features from Quark can be disabled? 

A: All of the technical changes and Redstone can be disabled without problem. IDAS uses all the building blocks though.

 

Special thanks to:

My Patrons!!!

Howester1984 who helped me build the stronghold!

Cama, the author of the incredible music disc you find in the mod

The Bisect Hosting team and especially Perz for making the logo for this mod!

MegRae, I used her tutorial to build the hanging dragon chandelier in the portal room.

TelepathicGrunt, the author of Repurposed Structures. I used the files from their mod a ton for coding references.

YUNGNICKYOUNG for his jigsaw manager.

My cat Fonzy for sitting on my lap while I coded this entire thing. Having weights on your lap really helps you stay focused

title: Integrated Simply Swords
description: An addon for Simply Swords with modded compatibility
body:
Currently for (Neo)Forge 1.20.1

By Craisinlord and Qwerty97475

WHAT IS INTEGRATED SIMPLY SWORDS?

Integrated Simply Swords is a Simply Swords addon that aims to fill in the gaps with missing Swords when mods that add other weapon materials are installed.
Additionally, themed Unique Weapons are planned for some specific mods/biomes/concepts.

It's mainly made for the Integrated MC modpack, and mods in there are more likely to be given compat priority, but you are welcome to use this in your own pack!

Suggestions for mod compat are also welcome!

Textures by Qwerty97475


Required mods:
Simply Swords
Architectury API
Cloth Config API

Optional supported mods:
Better Combat
Ice and Fire: Dragons

Caverns & Chasms
Galosphere
Eidolon: Repraised
Oreganized
Born in Chaos
Planned supported mods:
The Aether
Other similar Simply Swords addons:

Knave's Needs

Simply Swords Modded Compatibility


DISCLAIMER:
Integrated MC

Integrated Simply Swords' main function is to add modded Simply Swords compat for mods in the Integrated Minecraft modpack. This means mods in Integrated Minecraft will be prioritised for integration over those which are not in the modpack.

Additionally, changes may be made in Integrated Simply Swords that do not reflect the base mod. For example, textures may be based off resourcepacks rather than a mod's original textures.



Integration Criteria

A toolset will be considered for integration only if it meets all these criteria:


Has a Sword, Axe, Pickaxe, Shovel, Hoe, etc - if the mod author doesn't consider a tool to require these then it's probably not a good idea to add Simply Swords for it.
Same Minecraft Version as Integrated Simply Swords - we aren't going to port this modv to other versions just to add compat for more mods.

Has quality textures - I don't want to work with bad palettes to make new textures, however if the mod has a good resourcepack it might be more likely to be considered.
Popular mod - otherwise it's not worth the time spent to add compat compared to adding compat for a more popular mod.

![](https://i.imgur.com/g47qxf6.jpg)

WHAT IS INTEGRATED DUNGEONS AND STRUCTURES?

          Integrated Dungeons and Structures (aka IDAS) is a mod that adds heavily detailed structures using blocks and mobs from Quark, Alex’s Mobs, and Create, with optional integrated with many other mods. I got sick of installing structure mods into a pack and roaming the world, only to find vanilla items and nothing of difficulty anywhere. I love detailed builds and Create machines, so I decided to make a mod that adds exactly what I’ve been missing. Beautiful and challenging dungeons and structures packed with lore that are fully integrated into multiple core forge mods.   If you’re new to this mod I highly recommend locating a Labyrinth, Tinker’s Workshop, Ancient Mines or a Pillager Fortress and playing through it. Those took by FAR the most time to build and I believe they are genuinely very fun and rewarding. Good luck!   Check out my other projects! * Integrated Minecraft, the official modpack for the Integrated Structures series * Integrated Stronghold
 * Integrated Villages   Configuration and optional Integration:

For 1.16

Edit the config files
IDAS automatically detects if Ice and Fire is installed and will change some structures loot and mobs


For 1.18 and above
To enable BOP integration, download this datapack.
To enable Alex's Mobs integrated, download this datapack

To configure anything else, download this datapack

  • To change spawn rates change the spacing and separation in the structures sets. Spacing is the Average distance between two neighboring generation attempts. Value between 0 and 4096
    Separation is the Minimum distance in chunks between two neighboring attempts. Value between 0 and 4096. Can't be bigger than spacing
  • To edit biomes, edit the biome files in tags/worldgen/biome/has structure
  • To disable structures, remove all the biomes for their tag list or raise the separation and spacing to crazy high numbers
  • To improve compatibility with other structure mods, add structures to the “structure set to avoid” list in each of the worldgen/configured_structure_feature files

 

Note: When using the global datapacks mod, if you’re using both the BOP and config data packs, you have to manually make sure that the data pack for bop integration is above the config data pack.

Over 50 unique heavily detailed structures in the Overworld and Nether dimensions including:

-  20 unique small and detailed world building structures such as campsites, markets, animal dens, and more

-  7 Endgame level dungeons ranging from expansive dwarven mines to the desert Labyrinth to the Pillager Fortress

-  Create themed Dungeons with spinning death traps such as the Tinker's Workshop

-  15 unique houses and inns for weary travelers

 - 6 magical wizard and enchanting towers to explore

-  Sunken pirate ships

-  Villager Castles

-  Magic towers and portals to explore in the nether

-  Event based structures such as the Winter Wagon and Haunted Manor

 

Planned Features:

 

- Underground dungeon variants

- More Nether and End structures

- Join my discord to make suggestions and vote on what structures get added next!

 

If you have trouble finding one of these structures, just start typing `/locate idas` into the chat and you should find a list of all the structures. For example, typing `/locate idas:castle` will find the closest Castle to your location.

## WHAT IS INTEGRATED VILLAGES?
 Integrated Villages is the third mod in the Integrated Structures series. Not only does it completely overhaul the boring old Minecraft Villages with tons of heavily detailed houses to explore, but it integrates Supplementaries/Quark decorations and Create mod doors, puzzles, traps, and over 30 other mods. I got sick of installing structure mods into a pack and roaming the world, only to find vanilla items and nothing of difficulty anywhere. I love detailed builds and Create machines, so I decided to make mods that adds exactly what I’ve been missing. Beautiful and challenging dungeons and structures packed with lore that are fully integrated into multiple core mods.

Check out my other mods!
- Integrated Stronghold
- Integrated Dungeons and Structures (IDAS)

## Configuration and optional Integration

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
By default IV disables vanilla villages from spawning, you can change this in the config file.

To configure anything else, download this [https://curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/integrated-villages-configuration](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/integrated-villages-configuration)

To change spawn rates change the spacing and separation in the structures sets. Spacing is the Average distance between two neighboring generation attempts. Value between 0 and 4096
Separation is the Minimum distance in chunks between two neighboring attempts. Value between 0 and 4096. Can't be bigger than spacing

To edit biomes, edit the biome files in tags/worldgen/biome/has structure

To disable structures, remove the structures from the structure set file

To improve compatibility with other structure mods, add structure SETS to the “structure set to avoid” list in each of the tags/worldgen/structure_set files

Configuration for what workstations appear from mods you have installed will be coming soon!

</details>

## Frequently Asked Questions

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
Q: What biome mods are compatible?
A: Most biome mods are compatible and integrated including Terralith, BOP, and Regions Unexplored.

Q: Will you backport/update to ___?
A: I will always keep the mod up to date with the newest versions of Minecraft as the dependencies update. It is very unlikely but not impossible for me to do a backport.

Q: Does this mod work with other structures mods?
A: Yes all of Yung's mods, Repurposed Structures and more will all work with zero issues. 


Q: Can I use this mod in a modpack?
A: Yes! I would love it if this mod gets used in packs.
 

Q: Can this mod be only on the server-side?
A: No, due to its custom music discs and soundtrack, and changes to client side structure blocks
</details>

title: Antarchy
description: Adding 45+ mobs, 8+ bosses, 3 fleshed out dimensions, and more
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1821/285/antarchy_bigb1-copy-png.png)

This mod requires Integrated API, Geckolib, Sizeable Foliage, and optionally Infinite Dimensions

  ## **What is Antarchy?** Antarchy includes 3 fleshed-out dimensions, infinite randomly generated dimensions, 45+ mobs, 8 bosses, insane weapons, dungeons, and more. All of this is up to quality in terms of design and looks with modern Minecraft mods. I want this mod to make you feel like a kid discovering mods for the first time. I am making the perfect mod for my child-self and hopefully yours as well!     *** ## **![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/ANTARCHY/MP_ANTARCHY_Features.webp)**

Ants

  • Brown Ants, Termites, and Rainbow ants spawn in the overworld in Ant Nests, and Red Ants spawn in the Nether. They work similarly to vanilla bees and are stored inside the nest blocks. 
  • Ants form marches to look for food. They open chests and pick up food items nearby and bring them back to thier nests.
  • Brown ants take you to Elythia, Red ants to Throaxis, Termites to Cavaryn, and the Rainbow Ants to... infinite randomly generated dimensions!
  • Once you feed Rainbow Ants Rainbow Sugar, crafted with Uranium nuggets, you can activate them. Once activated each rainbow ant stores a randomly generated dimension inside of it. Don't loose the ant, you'll loose the dimension forever!
  • You can eat rainbow sugar while in a Rainbow Ant dimension to return home.

 

Additionally, you can create portals to Thoraxis, Elythia, and Cavaryn by killing an ant inside the correct portal frame. For the Red Ant, you need Nyxite. For the Brown ant, you need mossy ouranwood wood. For termite, you need Myrmite. I know, it's so sad the poor ants have to go to make the portals

Uranium, Titanium, and Ultimate Gear

  • Antarchy adds two new ores you can find that are much rarer than diamond. Each ore only gives one nugget.
  • These are used to craft the Ultimate Armor, Ultimate Tools with toggle-able 3x3 mining, Squidzooka, Gravity Gun, R.P.O. Launcher, and the Shrink and Growth Rays.
  • Uranium and Titanium also have full block sets.
  • Ultiamte Mace and Ultimate Trial chambers coming soon :)

The Brown Ant Dimension, AKA Elythia

  • Elythia is a lush paradise with towering Ouranwood forests and vast rolling meadows
  • Try to tame yourself a flying squirrel and find the Brutalfly in it's massive caccoon
  • It also contains various statues and nostalgic structures you may recognize!

 

 

The Red Ant Dimension, AKA Thoraxis

  • Thoraxis isn't quite as nice as Elythia. Even the plants try to kill you! This nightmare of a dimension is built around the mechanic of inverted gravity. Various mobs, gesyers, and blocks will give you the inverted effect, flipping your gravity to upwards. This might be one of the hardest dimensions in all of modded mc, good luck! :)

 

Cavaryn, aka the Termite Dimension

  • Cavaryn is a horrifying place full of all sorts of creepy crawls. Plus Stink Bug and Rolly Pollys!

Big Bertha

  • Crafted with mobs drops from all over Antarchy, this is the new best weapon in any modpack.
  • It has a mode for each boss used to make it, granting you all of thier abilites!

The Kraken

  • The Kraken Boss can be summoned by killing squids, so be careful where you swing your sword!
  • It is the hardest boss in the game, summoning lightning, flying around, and shooting Octopus Bombs and Missile squids at you.

 

Planned Features

  • King in Elyhia, Queen in Thoraxis
  • Whatever I feel like adding on any given day!
  *** **![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/ANTARCHY/MP_ANTARCHY_Faq.webp)**

 

Q: Will you backport to X?
A: Probably not. I will update the mod to later versions as they become popular but it's much easier for me to maintain and improve the mod on one version. Fabric version might be coming though.

Q: Are you affiliated with the Orespawn mod?
A: Antarchy does not have any affiliation with the original Orespawn mod and uses no assets or code from the original. The mod is very distinct with almost as much original content as content from Orespawn.

Q: Can I use this mod in a modpack?
A: Yes! Go crazy!

Q: How do I configure/change _?
A; There is a ridiculous amount of config options for you to tune the mod. If it's not in the config it might be something you can change with a datapack. If you want something added to the config let me know and I'll make it configurable!

Join the [discord if you have any other questions or want to follow the mods development!](https://discord.com/invite/72a7jmc5mb) *** ## **Credits** **CraisinLord:** Creator, coding, sound design **Laynce**: Ideas and balancing, sound design, trailer **inkgum:** Duct tape, Ouranwood, Mud pie, Torchflower bush, Milkweed, Peach wood, Camellia, Spider Lily, Corn blocks and items **Napino:** All other block/item textures and item 3D Models **Im2Kiwi4This**: Butterfly, Caterpillar, Brutalfly, Basilisk, Octopus Bomb, Missile Squid **ItsSmudgy**: Creeping Horror, Bomber, Mantis, Wasp, Lurking Terror, Jerry **Ferrum**: Molevore, Moleworm **Karlljp**: Every single other mob. AND he reextured most of the mobs listed above. HUGEE thanks for Karl, this mob would not have been possible without him. **Nakuring**: The Incredible boss bars. *** ## **Support Us** I like paying artists well, so I personally spent a lot of money on this project. Any money I get from my Patreon or Bisect goes right back into adding more content into the mod :)
